title: A Little King with a Good Heart
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Josiah was a little boy,
Just eight years old was he,
They put a crown upon his head,
A king he came to be.

[Chorus]
I’m never too young to be good,
To choose what’s right today,
Heavenly Father’s glad when I
Am kind and choose His way.

[Verse 2]
He had a good and tender heart,
He did not turn aside,
He didn’t say, “I’m much too small,”
He made the Lord his guide.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now rest your head, my little one,
Though you are young and small,
Your good choices are big and bright,
And God hears when you call.

[Chorus]
mood: Twinkling music. A light, tick-tock pulse skips gently under the voice, small and bright like a boy wearing a crown that is a little too big, matching Josiah's young and cheerful goodness. The chorus keeps that playful lift but sings it with quiet confidence. By the last verse the ticking slows and softens, the tune drops lower, and the little melody winds down like a toy at the end of its turn.
